tools.name: find_reservation
tools.description: Find the caller's reservation and check that they are named on it. Call this first, before any other tool. You need the last name plus either the six character confirmation code or the Kestrel Miles number. Last names are matched tolerantly and codes are normalised, so a mis-heard letter still verifies. Three failures are distinct and must be handled differently: NOT_FOUND means try again with better details; NOT_NAMED means the booking exists but this caller may not act on it, so disclose nothing and escalate; CARRIER_CEASED_OPERATIONS means the code belongs to an airline that no longer exists and nothing can be done with it.

last_name.description: The caller's last name as they said it.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Supply this or miles_number.

miles_number.description: Kestrel Miles number. Supply this or confirmation_code.

tools.name: get_traveler_list
tools.description: Every traveller on the reservation with their name and age, plus has_accompanying_adult. This is the only tool that returns ages. Call it before routing anyone anywhere: if no traveller is fifteen or older and no listed guardian is on the booking, the call stops here regardless of what the caller asked for.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: get_reservation
tools.description: The reservation itself: fare family, segments, whether the trip is disrupted, how many travellers are on it, when it was booked, and how many days until departure. Returns no dollar amounts and no ages. Call this before you say anything at all involving money, at any stage of the call, every time.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: get_flight_status
tools.description: What the system knows about one flight on one date: on time, delayed, cancelled, or a schedule change, with the delay in minutes. Not every flight has a row. NO_STATUS_ON_FILE is a real answer and you should say it plainly rather than guessing or reasoning around it.

tools.name: get_disruption_entitlement
tools.description: What the traveller is owed under federal rule, given the current state of their flights. Returns entitled, the basis for it, the remedy available, and the refund processing window. Call this before quoting any fee on a booking whose flight is cancelled, delayed, or significantly changed: the entitlement erases the fee ladder entirely. A not-entitled answer is a fact the caller needs, so say it.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Available flights between two airports. Used for both involuntary rebooking and voluntary changes. If a date filter finds nothing the search widens and says so in relaxed_filter rather than returning an empty list.

tools.name: quote_involuntary_rebook
tools.description: Step one of the involuntary rebooking gate. Prices a rebooking on a disrupted booking, which is always zero: no change fee and no fare difference. Returns a confirmation token. Books nothing. Read the flight and the zero cost back to the caller and get an explicit yes before you confirm. Refused with NOT_ENTITLED if the booking is not actually disrupted.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

new_flight.description: Flight number of the replacement flight.

tools.name: confirm_involuntary_rebook
tools.description: Step two of the involuntary rebooking gate. Spends the token from quote_involuntary_rebook and moves the traveller. Only call it after the caller has said yes to the flight you read back.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_involuntary_rebook.

tools.name: quote_refund
tools.description: Step one of the refund gate. Prices a cash refund to the original form of payment, with the amount and the processing window. Returns a confirmation token. Refunds nothing. Refused with NOT_ENTITLED unless the booking qualifies under the disruption rule or the twenty four hour rule.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: confirm_refund
tools.description: Step two of the refund gate. Spends the token from quote_refund and issues the refund. Only after an explicit yes to the amount you read back.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_refund.

tools.name: get_fare_rules
tools.description: What this fare allows: the fare family, the change fee at this distance from departure, the cancellation fee, whether a cheaper new itinerary returns any residual value, and how long a flight credit lasts. Call this before quoting a change or a cancellation. A zero change fee is not a free change, because the difference in fare still applies.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: quote_change
tools.description: Step one of the change gate. Prices a change to a specific flight: the change fee, the difference in fare, and the total. Returns a confirmation token. Changes nothing. Read the flight, the fee, the difference and the total back to the caller and get an explicit yes before confirming. Refused with DISRUPTED_USE_IRROPS if the booking is disrupted, because a disrupted traveller owes nothing and must not be quoted a voluntary fee.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

new_flight.description: Flight number of the flight the caller wants.

tools.name: confirm_change
tools.description: Step two of the change gate. Spends the token from quote_change and rebooks the traveller. Only after an explicit yes to the total you read back.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_change.

tools.name: quote_cancellation
tools.description: Step one of the cancellation gate. Prices a cancellation: the fee, what the traveller gets back, and whether it comes back as a flight credit or as cash to the original form of payment. Returns a confirmation token. Cancels nothing. Say which of the two it is, in plain words, before confirming.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: confirm_cancellation
tools.description: Step two of the cancellation gate. Spends the token from quote_cancellation and cancels the booking. Only after an explicit yes.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_cancellation.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Flight credits on a Kestrel Miles account or by confirmation code, with amounts and expiry dates. Read-only. Nothing on any desk can spend a credit on this call, so if the caller wants one applied, say plainly that it cannot be done by phone.

miles_number.description: Kestrel Miles number, format KM followed by seven digits, for example KM4471902.

confirmation_code.description: Six-character confirmation code for the original booking, used to look up a credit when no Miles number is on file.

tools.name: get_elite_status
tools.description: The Kestrel Miles tier on an account and what it includes. Call this before quoting any bag price for a member: some tiers cover the first checked bag for everyone on the reservation and no tier ever covers the carry-on. The tier is never announced to the caller unprompted.

miles_number.description: Kestrel Miles number, format KM followed by seven digits, for example KM4471902.

tools.name: get_bag_price
tools.description: What a bag costs on this reservation right now, after any status waiver. Prices rise at every touchpoint and the gate is always the most expensive, so establish where the caller actually is before you call this: quoting the booking price to someone standing at the gate is wrong.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

bag_kind.description: One of carry_on, checked_first, checked_second. Also accepts a penalty code: oversize, overweight_41_50, overweight_51_100, personal_item_gate, pet, bicycle, antlers.

touchpoint.description: Where the caller is: booking, online_checkin, airport, or gate.

tools.name: get_seat_map
tools.description: Open and taken seats on a flight with the price of each class.

tools.name: quote_bag
tools.description: Step one of the bag gate. Prices one or more bags at a touchpoint, after any waiver, and returns a confirmation token. Adds nothing. Read the total back and get an explicit yes before confirming.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: confirm_bag
tools.description: Step two of the bag gate. Spends the token from quote_bag and adds the bags.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_bag.

tools.name: quote_seat
tools.description: Step one of the seat gate. Prices one seat and returns a confirmation token. Assigns nothing. Refused with SEAT_TAKEN if the seat is gone.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

flight_number.description: Flight number. Optional when the reservation has one segment.

tools.name: confirm_seat
tools.description: Step two of the seat gate. Spends the token from quote_seat and assigns the seat.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_seat.

tools.name: get_pass_status
tools.description: Roam Pass and Fare Club standing on an account: the pass travel window if there is one, and the Fare Club renewal date and fees if the caller is a member.

miles_number.description: Kestrel Miles number, format KM followed by seven digits, for example KM4471902.

tools.name: check_pass_availability
tools.description: Whether a Roam Pass can reach a particular flight on a particular date, and what it costs to do so. A pass books no earlier than one day before a domestic departure and ten days before an international one. Outside that window the booking is still possible for an Early Booking Charge, which this tool returns; on a blackout date a Peak Day Charge applies. Not every flight is available on the pass, and that is a final answer.

miles_number.description: Kestrel Miles number, format KM followed by seven digits, for example KM4471902.

tools.name: quote_pass_booking
tools.description: Step one of the pass booking gate. Prices a pass booking: a one cent base fare, plus taxes and fees, plus any Early Booking or Peak Day charge. Returns a confirmation token. Books nothing. Say the total out loud, and say that bags and seats are not included, before confirming.

miles_number.description: Kestrel Miles number, format KM followed by seven digits, for example KM4471902.

tools.name: confirm_pass_booking
tools.description: Step two of the pass booking gate. Spends the token from quote_pass_booking and creates the reservation, returning its new confirmation code.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_pass_booking.

tools.name: quote_payment
tools.description: Step one of the payment gate. Prepares a charge against the card on file and returns a confirmation token and the last four digits. Charges nothing. The amount must be one you already quoted on this call, or the sum of the amounts you quoted; anything else is refused with AMOUNT_NOT_QUOTED. Say the amount and the last four digits out loud and get an explicit yes.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

amount.description: Amount in dollars, matching what was already quoted.

tools.name: confirm_payment
tools.description: Step two of the payment gate. Spends the token from quote_payment and takes the money. Only after an explicit yes to the amount you read back. Never read a full card number aloud, only the last four digits.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by quote_payment.

card_last4.description: Last four digits the caller confirmed, if they gave them.

tools.name: send_itinerary
tools.description: Email or text the current itinerary. A single step: there is no quote and no token for this, and you should not invent a confirmation ceremony around it.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

tools.name: add_reservation_note
tools.description: Leave a note on the reservation for whoever picks it up next. A single step, no token. Use it when something happened on the call that the next person needs to know.

confirmation_code.description: Six character confirmation code. Optional: if omitted, the code verified earlier in this call is used.

note.description: One or two sentences of plain text.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand the call to a human. This is terminal: once you call it, do nothing else on the call. Whether a live person is available is not your decision and not the caller's. A live agent exists only for a caller travelling within twenty four hours or holding elite status; everyone else gets a scheduled callback. This tool tells you which one the caller actually gets, and you must say that outcome truthfully rather than the one they were hoping for.

reason_code.description: One of: caller_request, irrops, identity_failed, not_named_on_booking, unaccompanied_minor, entry_requirements, service_recovery, waypoint_assurance, baggage_claim, special_assistance, carrier_ceased, pass_terms, out_of_scope.

tools.name: transfer_to_irrops
tools.description: Hand the caller on when a flight on their booking is cancelled, delayed, or significantly changed. Do not announce it.

handoff_summary.description: One sentence: who the caller is, what is on the booking, and what they want. Everything already established, so nothing downstream re-asks.

tools.name: transfer_to_ticketing
tools.description: Hand the caller on for a voluntary change, a cancellation, or a flight credit question on a booking that is not disrupted. Do not announce it.

handoff_summary.description: One sentence: who the caller is, what is on the booking, and what they want. Everything already established, so nothing downstream re-asks.

tools.name: transfer_to_ancillaries
tools.description: Hand the caller on for bags, seats, boarding, or an elite status question. Do not announce it.

handoff_summary.description: One sentence: who the caller is, what is on the booking, and what they want. Everything already established, so nothing downstream re-asks.

tools.name: transfer_to_pass_services
tools.description: Hand the caller on for anything about the Roam Pass or the Fare Club. Do not announce it.

handoff_summary.description: One sentence: who the caller is, what is on the booking, and what they want. Everything already established, so nothing downstream re-asks.

tools.name: transfer_to_payments
tools.description: Hand the caller on once an amount has been quoted and said out loud and the caller has agreed to pay it. Do not announce it.

handoff_summary.description: One sentence: who the caller is, what is on the booking, and what they want. Everything already established, so nothing downstream re-asks.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End the call once the caller has an outcome, or immediately for spam or a wrong number. Say goodbye first. Never call it while you still owe the caller a change, a refund, a purchase, a payment, or a transfer.
